issues.summary: ResultTrampoline and EntryClickTrampoline invoke the application's std::function directly from SDL C callbacks, so an exception escaping it crosses SDL frames (undefined behaviour, typically std::terminate).
issues.public_contract: CNA::Devices::FileDialog result callbacks and CNA::Devices::SystemTray entry-click callbacks on the SDL3 platform

issues.title: Core's build files still carry dependencies its sources dropped: -lembind on Emscripten and a link probe that tolerates SDL3
issues.summary: modules/core/CMakeLists.txt still adds -lembind for every Emscripten consumer although the browser preference reader was rewritten with EM_JS to avoid embind, and probe_core still permits SDL3 although core no longer uses SDL.
issues.public_contract: The link interface of cna_core (CNA::Core) on Emscripten, and the probe_core link-closure check

issues.title: Stub_Smoke links SDL3::SDL3 unconditionally, so STUB + tests cannot be configured with CNA_ENABLE_SDL=OFF
issues.summary: The STUB renderer's smoke-test macro links SDL3::SDL3 in both branches and its source includes the SDL3 header, while CNA_ENABLE_SDL=OFF is a supported configuration; with STUB selected and tests on, the SDL-free configuration has no SDL3 target to link.
issues.public_contract: CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER=STUB with CNA_BUILD_TESTS=ON and CNA_ENABLE_SDL=OFF

issues.title: CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO=AUTO accepts any pkg-config FFmpeg, but VideoDecoder.cpp needs the FFmpeg 5.1 channel-layout API
issues.summary: The FFmpeg probe states no minimum version while VideoDecoder.cpp uses AVCodecContext::ch_layout and swr_alloc_set_opts2, so a host with older FFmpeg development packages enables video at configure time and then fails to compile.
issues.public_contract: CMake option CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO (AUTO, the default, and ON) and the cna_video_ffmpeg target

issues.title: modules/renderers/CMakeLists.txt enters the shared D3D and GDI helper directories only when DIRECTX11/12 or GDI is the default
issues.summary: Before its per-family loop the file adds common/d3d, and the GDI configuration of software, only when the default renderer matches, so a Windows multi-renderer build with DIRECTX11, DIRECTX12 or GDI as a non-default member lacks the targets it links.
issues.public_contract: CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS multi-renderer builds on Windows that cmake/RendererCombinations.cmake accepts

issues.title: Stub_Smoke needs SDL3 although the STUB renderer does not, so a STUB test build without SDL cannot configure
issues.summary: stub_smoke_test.cpp includes the SDL3 header unconditionally and the cna_stub_test macro links SDL3::SDL3 with no if(TARGET) guard, unlike the HEADLESS and SOFTWARE example files, so STUB with CNA_ENABLE_SDL=OFF and tests on fails at generate time.
issues.public_contract: Building the STUB renderer with CNA_BUILD_TESTS=ON (the default) and CNA_ENABLE_SDL=OFF

issues.title: The GDI renderer's configure message hard-codes '3 GDI-owned units' while modules/renderers/gdi/src compiles four
issues.summary: modules/renderers/gdi/CMakeLists.txt reports the GDI archive as the shared CPU-2D source count plus a literal 3, but cna_add_renderer globs four GDI translation units, so the reported total is one short.
issues.public_contract: The configure-time STATUS line 'CNA: GDI renderer archive = N shared CPU-2D sources + 3 GDI-owned units = M translation units' (GDI-078)

issues.title: modules/renderers/CMakeLists.txt enters common/d3d, the GDI software sources and the Metal renderer target only for the default identity, so a multi-renderer set naming DIRECTX11/12, GDI or METAL as a non-default member passes the combination rules and then cannot build
issues.summary: Three helper directories are entered by testing the default identity instead of set membership, yet the combination rules accept sets such as HEADLESS;DIRECTX11, whose DIRECTX11 family then links an undefined cna_renderer_d3dcommon.
issues.public_contract: CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS multi-renderer mode and cna_validate_renderer_combination (cmake/RendererCombinations.cmake): incompatible sets are rejected at configure time with a reason, never left to surface as a build error

issues.title: cna_configure_vendored_enet tells the user to run 'git submodule update --init third_party/enet', but ENet is committed in the tree, not a submodule
issues.summary: When third_party/enet/CMakeLists.txt is missing, cmake/ThirdPartyENet.cmake fails with advice to initialise a submodule that does not exist; ENet is ordinary tracked source, so the advice cannot restore it.
issues.public_contract: cmake/ThirdPartyENet.cmake cna_configure_vendored_enet (CNA_ENABLE_NET builds): the FATAL_ERROR shown when the vendored ENet source is absent

issues.title: metal-macos-ci.yml's push path filter names three CMake files that no longer exist and omits the files that now register the Metal tests
issues.summary: The Metal workflow's push filter lists three removed CMake files, while edits to modules/renderers/metal/CMakeLists.txt or its examples/CMakeLists.txt, where the Metal_* CTests are registered, do not trigger it.
issues.public_contract: .github/workflows/metal-macos-ci.yml, on.push.paths

issues.title: general-tests-ci.yml still allowlists EasyGL_GraphicsDevice_ReferenceStencil as a known failure after REMED-GFX-236 fixed it, so a regression of that test cannot turn the job red
issues.summary: The only unfiltered CI job classifies failures against a one-entry KNOWN_FAILURES list whose entry is the EasyGL ReferenceStencil test, which CNA's own record says now passes; if EasyGL's ReferenceStencil override breaks again, the job stays green.
issues.public_contract: .github/workflows/general-tests-ci.yml, step 'Classify failures (known pre-existing vs. genuinely new regressions)': KNOWN_FAILURES

issues.title: The SDL2-only configuration guard recommends VULKAN, which the SDL2 platform cannot run
issues.summary: Sdl2OnlyConfiguration.cmake's error text lists VULKAN among the SDL-independent renderers to choose, but Sdl2Platform::GetVulkanSurface returns null, so a VULKAN build on SDL2 can only fail later at GraphicsDevice construction.
issues.public_contract: cmake/Sdl2OnlyConfiguration.cmake's diagnostic recommending SDL-independent renderers

issues.title: The SDL2-only guard inspects only CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER, so a multi-renderer list containing an SDL3-linked family is not refused
issues.summary: Sdl2OnlyConfiguration.cmake checks the scalar CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER but never the CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS list, so an SDL2-only build whose list includes an SDL3-linked family passes the guard meant to keep two SDL majors apart.
issues.public_contract: cmake/Sdl2OnlyConfiguration.cmake's protection against linking SDL2 and SDL3 into one binary

issues.title: CNA_X11_HAVE_VULKAN_HEADERS is defined by the X11 CMake but read by no source, so the dependency summary implies a Vulkan-header gate that does not exist
issues.summary: PlatformX11.cmake defines CNA_X11_HAVE_VULKAN_HEADERS and lists Vulkan headers as an optional dependency, but no X11 source reads the macro; the X11 Vulkan surface is created unconditionally and resolves its entry point at run time.
issues.public_contract: cmake/PlatformX11.cmake's CNA_X11_HAVE_VULKAN_HEADERS definition and the X11 dependency summary

issues.title: cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64.cmake falls back to the i686 compiler but keeps CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR x86_64, so the persistent SDL install key mislabels a 32-bit build
issues.summary: When x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc is missing the toolchain silently selects i686-w64-mingw32 yet still declares x86_64, which becomes part of the .sdl-prebuilt-Windows-x86_64 cache key; its header comment also still requires a pre-built SDL on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH.
issues.public_contract: cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64.cmake (MinGW-w64 cross toolchain file)

issues.title: Link-closure tests pass --build-dir ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}, so when CNA is added as a subproject they look for link.txt in the consumer's build root and always skip
issues.summary: The probe targets are defined in CNA's own root directory, whose binary directory is a subdirectory of the consumer's build tree; the checker is pointed at the top-level build root instead and never finds CMakeFiles/<probe>.dir/link.txt.
issues.public_contract: cmake/Tests/ModuleProbes.cmake ModuleLinkClosure_* --build-dir argument

issues.title: Six CI workflows pin August 2026 sharp-runtime commits that lack the Resources component CNA's default closure requests, so they stop at configure
issues.summary: Since Resources joined CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_DEFAULT_COMPONENTS, the workflows pinned to sharp-runtime bc8dbf41, f23ded28 or df1b42ab request a component those revisions do not register, and sharp-runtime ends configuration with 'Unknown Sharp Runtime component'.
issues.public_contract: htmldom-ci.yml, devices-tests.yml, emscripten-multi-renderer-ci.yml, apple-ci.yml, metal-macos-ci.yml and content-pipeline-windows-ci.yml; SHARP_RUNTIME_COMPONENTS

issues.title: The registered CTest CNAEXT_NoPosixSetenv fails at this snapshot: twelve Wayland setenv/unsetenv call lines trip the gate
issues.summary: scripts/check_no_posix_setenv.py forbids POSIX setenv/unsetenv under modules/, tools/ and tests/, but the native Wayland backend and its tests added twelve such lines on 2026-09-15, so the gate CNA registers in every test-enabled tree exits 1.
issues.public_contract: CTest CNAEXT_NoPosixSetenv (modules/graphics-ext/examples/CMakeLists.txt, label CnaExt)

issues.title: StorageDeviceDeleteContainerTest writes to and deletes inside the developer's real per-user data directory
issues.summary: The StorageDevice deletion tests resolve their fixture root from the real XDG_DATA_HOME/LOCALAPPDATA/HOME environment, remove_all() it in TearDown, and then recreate the default game's save directory, while a comment still reasons about an SDL preference path.
issues.public_contract: StorageDeviceDeleteContainerTest fixture (SetUp, TearDown) in CnaTests

issues.title: In a multi-renderer build, non-default renderers' example CTests are registered but run under the default renderer
issues.summary: The SDL_GPU, SOFTWARE, STUB and VULKAN example blocks are entered for a non-default member of CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS, yet their registrations select no renderer, so each executable runs under the build default.
issues.public_contract: Renderer example CTests (SdlGpu_*, Software_*, Stub_Smoke, Vulkan_*) in a CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS build, including CNA's multi-renderer preset

issues.title: SdlGpu_2D_HeadlessDriver forces headless mode under the x11 video driver that the SDL_GPU constructor refuses for it
issues.summary: On non-Windows hosts the SDL_GPU headless registrations reuse the ordinary test environment (SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11 by default), but SdlGpu_2D_HeadlessDriver also sets CNA_SDLGPU_TEST_FORCE_HEADLESS=1, which the constructor accepts only under dummy or offscreen.
issues.public_contract: The SdlGpu_2D_HeadlessDriver CTest (SDLGPU-102) and the CNA_SDLGPU_TEST_VIDEO_DRIVER cache option

issues.title: CnjEffectTest.LoadsRealCnjFixture expects a valid GLSL ES effect on any renderer that executes shader source with a non-HLSL dialect, which SDL_GPU with libshaderc cannot compile
issues.summary: The test's expectation helper returns Valid for SDL_GPU (custom effects executed, SpirV dialect), but SDL_GPU's Vulkan-rule GLSL route rejects the GLSL ES 3.00 fixture, so a CnaTests run defaulting to SDL_GPU would fail.
issues.public_contract: modules/content/tests CnjEffectTest.LoadsRealCnjFixture (ExpectedGlslEffectValidity)

issues.title: SDL_Renderer_ClearOptions_Audit encodes Clear semantics that no longer exist and catches the wrong exception type, so it cannot pass at this snapshot
issues.summary: Clear now throws System::InvalidOperationException for any missing depth or stencil aspect, but the test expects Stencil-only clears not to throw and catches only std::runtime_error, which that exception does not derive from.
issues.public_contract: modules/renderers/sdl-renderer/examples/sdlrenderer_clearoptions_audit_test.cpp (CTest SDL_Renderer_ClearOptions_Audit)

issues.title: Software_XnaLineCoverage passes when a scene differs from the XNA reference: run-oracle-corpus-diff-software.sh fails only on render errors
issues.summary: The CTest described as the exact Software regression for the two aliased-line scenes runs a script that prints DIFF for a pixel mismatch and still exits 0; only a missing reference or a failed render makes it fail.
issues.public_contract: CTest Software_XnaLineCoverage (modules/renderers/software/examples/CMakeLists.txt)

issues.title: Delta-maintained diagnostics gauges such as Audio/AllocatedVoices drift after a runtime OFF window
issues.summary: GaugeHandle::Add discards deltas while the runtime mode is OFF, so a gauge kept with GAUGE_ADD(+1/-1), such as Audio/AllocatedVoices, stays wrong (too high, or negative) after statistics are re-enabled, until mixer shutdown resets it.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Diagnostics::GaugeHandle::Add and CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_GAUGE_ADD across SetRuntimeMode(Mode::Off); the documented meaning of Audio/AllocatedVoices

issues.title: On Emscripten a diagnostics frame excludes the requestAnimationFrame wait, so FrameSample.framesPerSecond is a work rate there
issues.summary: The web loop opens the frame scope inside EmscriptenMainLoopCallback and waits for the next animation frame after it returns, so web frame durations and FPS exclude pacing, unlike the native Tick the documentation describes.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Diagnostics::FrameSample (durationNs, framesPerSecond) as published by Game's frame scope

issues.title: Inspector ServerHello.graphicsRenderer reports the compile-time default renderer, not the one GraphicsRendererSelection actually created
issues.summary: The Inspector session names the build's default renderer identity, so in a multi-renderer build where a preference, the environment variable or a fallback selects another renderer, the Session view shows the wrong one.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector::HelloResponse::graphicsRenderer (the Session view's renderer) versus CNA::GraphicsRendererSelection::GetActive()

issues.title: A diagnostics name or resource label longer than 4,096 bytes makes every Inspector snapshot or event batch that contains it fail with LimitExceeded
issues.summary: Diagnostics accepts names up to 1 MiB and labels of any length, but the Inspector protocol caps strings at 4,096 bytes and refuses the whole response, so one long name breaks the affected Inspector views for the rest of the process.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector protocol v1 SnapshotResponse and EventsResponse encoding (ProtocolCodec::Encode) over diagnostics provider v1 data

issues.title: Agent::Stop can wait up to about six seconds for a connection accepted just before Stop runs
issues.summary: Stop shuts down only a client already published as activeClient_, so a connection accepted in the window before the worker publishes it keeps join waiting on that client's handshake reads, up to 3 s for the header and 3 s for the payload.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector::Agent::Stop() and ~Agent()

issues.title: cna_graphics_resource_get_graphics_device returns CNA_RESULT_INVALID_HANDLE for every resource created on a caller-created GraphicsDevice
issues.summary: A resource made on a device from cna_graphics_device_create carries that device's handle as its owner token, and the route passes it to the game-only BorrowGameGraphicsDevice, so asking such a valid resource for its device always fails.
issues.public_contract: cna_graphics_resource_get_graphics_device(CNA_Handle resource, CNA_Handle* out_graphics_device) (CNA/C/graphics_resource.h) for resources created on a cna_graphics_device_create device

issues.title: audio.h and AUDIO.md call cna_dynamic_sound_effect_instance_submit_buffer safe from a producer thread, but every call off the creation thread returns CNA_RESULT_THREAD
issues.summary: The submission routes resolve the instance through HandleRegistry::Get, which refuses any thread other than the handle's creation thread, so the documented canonical producer-thread usage fails; AUDIO.md's own threading section states the stricter rule.
issues.public_contract: cna_dynamic_sound_effect_instance_submit_buffer, cna_dynamic_sound_effect_instance_submit_float_buffer_ext

issues.title: docs/c-api/HANDLES.md documents CNA_RESULT_SHUTTING_DOWN for a closing or closed runtime, but no C API route ever returns it
issues.summary: abi.h defines CNA_RESULT_SHUTTING_DOWN and HANDLES.md maps a closing runtime to it, but no route returns it and the registry has no shutdown state, so a stale handle answers CNA_RESULT_INVALID_HANDLE.
issues.public_contract: CNA_RESULT_SHUTTING_DOWN (abi.h); the HANDLES.md validation table

issues.title: GraphicsRendererSelection::IsLatched() is documented to latch when the first GraphicsDevice begins construction; it latches only on successful resolution

issues.title: SDL_GPU accepts ShaderEffect GLSL only in Vulkan-rule form (#version 450, explicit locations and SDL_gpu sets), so the shared GLSL ES 3.00 .cnj effect fixture does not load there
issues.summary: SdlGpuEffectRenderer::CompileProgram passes GLSL to libshaderc for SPIR-V, which rejects GLSL ES 3.00 sources and implicit uniform bindings; CNA's portable .cnj effect fixture is written in GLSL ES 3.00.
issues.public_contract: ShaderEffect construction from GLSL source and ContentManager::Load of GLSL .cnj effects on SDL_GPU

issues.title: DIRECTX9 BasicEffect reaches only 12 of its 32 shader variants; other combinations throw 'no matching CNA vertex layout'
issues.summary: Only strides 16, 20, 24, 32 and 52 have vertex declarations, so BasicEffect variants needing position-only, position+normal or colour+normal inputs (including untextured per-pixel lighting) cannot draw.
issues.public_contract: BasicEffect draws on DIRECTX9

issues.title: DIRECTX9 ignores mipMap for RenderTarget2D (single level, GetData above level 0 throws) and ignores the MSAA request for RenderTargetCube
issues.summary: CreateRenderTarget2D discards the mipMap argument and CreateRenderTargetCube discards mipMap and multiSampleCount, so mip chains are never generated and cube targets are never multisampled on DIRECTX9.
issues.public_contract: RenderTarget2D(mipMap = true) and RenderTargetCube(multiSampleCount > 0) on DIRECTX9

issues.title: On DIRECTX9 a Texture2D can only be created with SurfaceFormat::Color
issues.summary: DIRECTX9 leaves ClassifySurfaceFormatEXT at its Defer default, so Texture2D creation falls back to a Color-only check although the renderer maps D3D formats internally; XNB textures still load because the reader converts them to RGBA.
issues.public_contract: Texture2D constructors with a SurfaceFormat other than Color on DIRECTX9

issues.title: DIRECTX11 and DIRECTX12 never enter DXGI exclusive full screen
issues.summary: Neither renderer calls IDXGISwapChain::SetFullscreenState; exclusiveFullscreen_ is declared and read (it disables tearing) but never set, so full screen is always the platform's borderless window.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDeviceManager.IsFullScreen / ToggleFullScreen on DIRECTX11 and DIRECTX12

issues.title: DIRECT2D refuses additive blending (SourceAlpha/One and One/One) and other asymmetric or non-Add blend states, and reports AdditiveBlending false
issues.summary: BlendStateToDirect2DBlendMode throws NotSupportedException for BlendState::Additive and One/One and std::runtime_error for asymmetric or non-Add combinations, because Direct2D's composite modes have no matching operation.
issues.public_contract: SpriteBatch.Begin(..., BlendState::Additive or custom BlendState, ...) on DIRECT2D

issues.title: SDL_RENDERER cannot honour TextureAddressMode.Wrap or Mirror for SpriteBatch; a Wrap draw silently shows clamped pixels
issues.summary: SDL_RenderTexture's source-rectangle sampling has one fixed edge-clamping behaviour, SetSamplerAddressMode is not overridden, and CNA records the Wrap/Mirror decision (Tasks 686/687) as blocked.
issues.public_contract: SamplerState.AddressU/AddressV = Wrap or Mirror with SpriteBatch source rectangles beyond the texture on SDL_RENDERER

issues.title: HTML_DOM and SVG_DOM refuse back-buffer readback
issues.summary: GetBackBufferData throws on these renderers because their back buffer is a live DOM subtree that no browser API rasterises; only bound render targets can be read.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::GetBackBufferData on HTML_DOM and SVG_DOM

issues.title: The METAL renderer applies KHR_materials_specular factors only and samples neither specular texture
issues.summary: Every other PBR renderer samples specularTexture and specularColorTexture; METAL reads the factor and colour but not the two maps, which the renderer-policy test pins as factor-only.
issues.public_contract: PbrEffect rendering of KHR_materials_specular materials on the METAL renderer

issues.title: EasyGL GPU timers read 32-bit nanosecond results and cannot detect GL disjoint events
issues.summary: EasyGLGpuTimerRenderer reads GL_TIME_ELAPSED as a 32-bit value because meta-gl offers no 64-bit read or disjoint query, so results saturate near 4.29 s and only an all-ones disjoint result is rejected.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Graphics::GpuTimer and RenderPipeline pass timings (CNAEXT) on the EasyGL GL profiles

issues.title: FREEDIRECT stores SetPresentationMode but always letterboxes, and keeps the old physical scale after a virtual-resolution change once presenting has begun
issues.summary: FreeDirectRenderer::SetPresentationMode only records the mode because free-direct always letterboxes, and SetVirtualResolution after the first Present keeps the previous physical scale.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice presentation mode and virtual-resolution changes on FREEDIRECT

issues.title: ClusteredForwardEffect binds no material textures: many punctual lights cannot be combined with a texture set
issues.summary: The CNAEXT ClusteredForwardEffect shades with a base colour, metallic and roughness only, so a game that needs many lights gives up PbrEffect's texture set and shadowed punctual light, as the effect's own header states.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Graphics::ClusteredForwardEffect (CNAEXT engine layer)

issues.title: Engine-layer PBR limits: one punctual light per PbrEffect draw, 8-bit environment cubes, no back-face normal flip for double-sided materials, no alpha-tested shadow casters
issues.summary: PbrEffect takes one punctual light, EnvironmentProcessor builds its cubes as SurfaceFormat::Color, no stock or engine-layer shader reads a front-facing input to flip normals, and the shadow-caster shaders write depth without an alpha test.
issues.public_contract: PbrEffect::setPunctualLightEXT; CNA::Graphics::EnvironmentProcessor; PbrEffect::getDoubleSidedEXTProperty; the engine layer's shadow-caster passes

issues.title: CNA has no counterpart of XNA's MissingVertexShaderInput draw check, and renderers resolve a stock-effect draw that lacks an input differently
issues.summary: XNA refuses a draw whose vertex declaration lacks a semantic the shader reads; CNA has no such check, so EasyGL/OPENGL4 feed neutral values, WEBGPU substitutes, SDL_GPU throws and VULKAN aliases TEXCOORD1.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::DrawPrimitives / DrawIndexedPrimitives / DrawUserPrimitives with a stock effect whose required vertex semantic is missing from the VertexDeclaration

issues.title: The XNB DateTime reader discards the two DateTimeKind bits, so Utc and Local values load as plain tick counts
issues.summary: DateTimeReader masks off the two kind bits and returns System::DateTime(ticks) with an unspecified kind, and it does not convert a Local-kind value to local time as XNA does. The header justifies the deviation by System::DateTime not modelling a kind, but System::DateTime has a (ticks, DateTimeKind) constructor at TARGET, so that reason is stale.
issues.public_contract: XNB DateTime values read through ContentReader (DateTimeReader)

issues.title: Only the direct glTF route fills Model::CamerasEXT; models loaded from .cnj or .cnb carry no cameras
issues.summary: ReadGltfModel extracts the file's cameras into Model::CamerasEXT, but the offline gltf_to_cnj/gltf_to_cnb tools only count camera nodes, so a converted model arrives without its authored framing.
issues.public_contract: Model::getCamerasEXTProperty() on models loaded through .cnj and .cnb

issues.title: Runtime glTF import has no unit-scale option; only the offline converters can rescale a model
issues.summary: ContentManager's glTF reader always imports at unitScale 1.0, so a file not authored in metres must go through the offline converters: cna_tool_gltf_to_cnb --unit-scale, or the optional unitScale argument of cna_tool_gltf_to_cnj.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on .gltf/.glb

issues.title: EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing is not imported: each node keeps one placement and its per-instance transforms are dropped
issues.summary: A node declaring EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing is imported with its own single transform, so the file renders one copy where it describes many; the drop is reported per file (gpu-instancing-dropped).
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files using EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing

issues.title: Mirrored glTF placements keep the shared winding, so under the default cull mode they render back-facing
issues.summary: A placement whose world transform has a negative determinant is detected and reported (mirrored-winding-unapplied) but CNA neither reverses its winding nor changes cull state, and exposes no per-mesh flag for the application to do it.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files with negatively scaled or mirroring node transforms; Model::Draw

issues.title: The glTF vertex ABI carries two UV channels, one joint-influence set and one colour set; further sets are dropped and reported
issues.summary: TEXCOORD sets beyond the first two sampled ones, JOINTS_1/WEIGHTS_1 and later, and COLOR_1 and later are not imported; each loss is named in the import report.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> and the offline converters on glTF primitives with extra attribute sets

issues.title: A skinned glTF model cannot also carry rigid scene-node animation: tracks not driven by its skins are dropped
issues.summary: Model::Tag holds SkinningData for a skinned model, so scene-node clips whose tracks are not carried by a skin palette are dropped with the rigid-animation-dropped-on-skinned-model diagnostic.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files that animate non-joint nodes of a skinned model

issues.title: A glTF mesh placed by several nodes takes its morph-weight animation from the first of them only
issues.summary: ExtractMorphWeightTrack resolves a mesh to the first node in file order that instances it, so every placement plays that node's weights channel and channels on the other nodes are ignored.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files that animate morph weights of a multiply-instanced mesh

issues.title: CUBICSPLINE bone and node channels are sampled at key times and played back linearly between them
issues.summary: BuildTrack evaluates each channel's Hermite curve only at the union of key times, and AnimationPlayer then lerps/slerps between those keys, so the curve's shape between keys is lost.
issues.public_contract: AnimationPlayer and SkinnedModelEXT playback of glTF clips with CUBICSPLINE interpolation

issues.title: glTF skins with more than 72 joints are refused at import
issues.summary: BuildSkeleton throws for a skin above the 72-matrix GPU palette (SkinnedEffect::MaxBones), naming the joint count, instead of truncating it.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> and the offline converters on glTF skins with more than 72 joints

issues.title: glTF punctual lights are approximated as at most three directional lights; point and spot lights have no native support
issues.summary: KHR_lights_punctual is imported into XNA's three-directional-light model: point and spot lights become directional lights aimed at the origin, ranges and cones are ignored, and lights beyond three are dropped and counted.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Model> on glTF files using KHR_lights_punctual; the imported lights applied to BasicEffect/PbrEffect

issues.title: XACT features FAudio never finished are unimplemented: QUEUE and REPLACE_QUIETEST limits, band-pass track filters, reverb sends and DSP-preset RPCs
issues.summary: CNA reproduces FAudio's shipped behaviour: QUEUE and REPLACE_QUIETEST evict the oldest cue, a cue-level limit picks its victim from the whole bank, band-pass filters cannot be decoded, and reverb and DSP-preset RPC targets do nothing.
issues.public_contract: AudioEngine category and cue instance limits; XACT sound-bank track filters; Cue RPC evaluation; SoundEffectInstance reverb

issues.title: CNA has no sound-instance limit: InstancePlayLimitException is declared but never thrown
issues.summary: XNA throws InstancePlayLimitException when too many sound instances play and SoundEffect.Play returns false for it; CNA declares the type but no code path raises it.
issues.public_contract: SoundEffectInstance::Play(), SoundEffect::Play() and InstancePlayLimitException

issues.title: XACT wave-bank entries compressed as XMA/XMA2 or WMA produce no sound
issues.summary: WaveBank::GetSoundEffect returns null for XMA and WMA entries after printing a diagnostic to stderr, so cues using them are silent.
issues.public_contract: WaveBank loading and playback of XMA/XMA2 and WMA (xWMA) wave entries

issues.title: StorageContainer::OpenFile(file, mode, access, share) ignores its FileShare argument
issues.summary: The four-argument OpenFile accepts a FileShare value and discards it, because the Sharp Runtime FileStream it constructs has no share mode, so FileShare::None does not keep a second writer out.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Storage::StorageContainer::OpenFile(const std::string& file, FileMode, FileAccess, FileShare), the two shorter OpenFile overloads that forward to it, and the C route cna_storage_container_open_file_share

issues.title: StorageDevice::DeviceChanged is declared but never raised
issues.summary: The static event exists for API compatibility, but nothing in the snapshot raises it; genuine XNA 4.0 raises it through FrameworkCallbackLinker.StorageDeviceChanged when a storage device changes, and CNA's desktop storage root has no such change source.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Storage::StorageDevice::DeviceChanged

issues.title: Guide's fourteen Show* shell entry points and DelayNotifications are empty no-ops
issues.summary: ShowSignIn, ShowFriends, ShowMarketplace, ShowMessages, ShowComposeMessage, ShowGamerCard, ShowParty, ShowPartySessions, ShowPlayers, ShowPlayerReview, ShowFriendRequest, ShowGameInvite (both) and ShowAchievementsEXT do nothing.
issues.public_contract: Guide::Show* (fourteen overloads) and Guide::DelayNotifications

issues.title: Local gamer services have no catalogue, presence or profile data: achievement metadata is empty, Achievement::GetPicture throws, presence is never published and privileges are a fixed permissive constant
issues.summary: Achievements come back with only key, earned state and time; GetPicture throws NotImplementedException; SetPresenceModeStringEXT does nothing; GamerPrivileges allows everything and nothing enforces it; GamerProfile is synthetic except Region.
issues.public_contract: Achievement (Name, Description, GamerScore, DisplayBeforeEarned, GetPicture), GamerPresence, GamerPrivileges, GamerProfile

issues.title: Voice chat, party invites, NetworkMachine::RemoveFromSession, arbitration/TrueSkill events and QualityOfService bandwidth are not implemented
issues.summary: EnableSendVoice and SendPartyInvites are no-ops, RemoveFromSession throws NotImplementedException, the leaderboard and TrueSkill write events are never raised, and QualityOfService's bandwidth fields stay 0.
issues.public_contract: LocalNetworkGamer::EnableSendVoice, LocalNetworkGamer::SendPartyInvites, NetworkMachine::RemoveFromSession, NetworkSession leaderboard/TrueSkill events, QualityOfService

issues.title: The terminal window title is stored but never emitted, so SetTitle has no visible effect
issues.summary: TerminalWindow::SetTitle records the title and defers the OSC emission to the session, but the session prologue emits no title sequence and nothing else writes one, so a terminal window title is never shown.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Platform::IPlatformWindow::SetTitle(const std::string&) on the terminal platform

issues.title: TerminalSession does not restore or re-establish the terminal on job-control stop and continue (SIGTSTP/SIGCONT)
issues.summary: The session's restoring signal set covers termination and crash signals but not SIGTSTP/SIGCONT, so a Ctrl-Z that suspends a terminal game leaves the terminal in raw mode, the alternate screen and mouse reporting until the process is resumed.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Platform::Terminal::TerminalSession terminal restoration on job-control signals

issues.title: A foreign HWND adopted by handle is not subclassed and is absent from windows_, so the Win32 GL, Vulkan, relative-mouse and text-input services refuse it
issues.summary: AdoptWindowHandle wraps a foreign HWND without subclassing it or adding it to windows_, so it raises no CNA events and FindWindow cannot resolve its id; the WGL, Vulkan, relative-mouse and text-input services then reject it.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Platform::Win32::Win32Platform::AdoptWindowHandle(std::uintptr_t) for a window CNA did not create

issues.title: CNA::Devices host dialogs are minimal: message boxes are unparented with no default or cancel button, tray icons have no image API, and UrlLauncher passes any string to the OS
issues.summary: MessageBox passes a null parent window and SDL buttons without RETURNKEY/ESCAPEKEY defaults, SystemTray offers only a tooltip and menu, and UrlLauncher::Open forwards its argument unvalidated to the platform (ShellExecuteW 'open' on Win32).
issues.public_contract: CNA::Devices::MessageBox::Show, CNA::Devices::SystemTray, CNA::Devices::UrlLauncher::Open

issues.title: The native Win32 platform backend has no gamepad support, no IME composition events and no file drop
issues.summary: Win32Platform reports gamepad, joystick, haptics and IME as deliberately unsupported, handles no WM_IME_* message or Imm* call, and never raises GameWindow's FileDropEXT; raw mouse input and per-monitor DPI are implemented.
issues.public_contract: CNA_PLATFORM=WIN32: GamePad, text input composition, GameWindow::FileDropEXT

issues.title: In a MinGW-w64 cross tree CnaTests gets a Wine CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR only when the default renderer is DIRECTX9/11/12 or DIRECT2D is compiled in
issues.summary: For any other default renderer (for example SDL_RENDERER, the toolchain file's own usage example) gtest discovery (DISCOVERY_MODE PRE_TEST) and ctest try to execute the Windows CnaTests binary directly on the Linux host.
issues.public_contract: cmake/UnitTests.cmake CnaTests CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR chain; cross-compiled CTest runs

issues.title: No renderer or subsystem registers an IDiagnosticsSource, and nothing registers ResourceKind::AudioVoice resources
issues.summary: The diagnostics source seam for GPU timings and renderer statistics has no production implementation and no engine code registers audio-voice resource metadata, so those diagnostics and Inspector views stay empty at this snapshot.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Diagnostics::IDiagnosticsSource / RegisterSource and CNA::Diagnostics::ResourceKind::AudioVoice

issues.title: No renderer implements IResourcePreviewProvider, and the seam cannot cancel a preview ticket the agent abandons
issues.summary: Resource previews are unavailable in every real Inspector session because no CNA renderer installs a preview provider, and when a client disconnects the agent drops its pending tickets without telling the provider.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector::IResourcePreviewProvider (RequestPreview, PollPreview) and AgentConfiguration::previewProvider

issues.title: The C ABI has no route for 468 public C++ declarations that the coverage inventory records as planned
issues.summary: COVERAGE.md records 468 in-scope public C++ declarations without a C mapping (320 runtime surface added after the binding campaign, 134 CNB Model-v2 surface, 14 smaller seams), which is why the C ABI release gate reads Not ready.
issues.public_contract: CNA C ABI 0.29.0 (modules/c-api/include/CNA/C) against the public C++ surface of the modules it links

issues.title: A fixed-step TargetElapsedTime above 500 ms never produces an Update from Game::Tick, essentially the same ceiling XNA 4.0 has
issues.summary: With IsFixedTimeStep true, Game::Tick clamps the accumulator to MaxElapsedTime (500 ms) before its update loop, so a TargetElapsedTime above 500 ms is never reached: Update does not run while Draw keeps running about twice a second. XNA 4.0's Tick has essentially the same ceiling (about 508 ms, because of its 1/64 snap), so the limit is inherited; the setter accepts such a value silently.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Game::setTargetElapsedTimeProperty(const System::TimeSpan&) with IsFixedTimeStep true; Game::Tick()

issues.title: WEBGPU does not propagate a real device loss: OnDeviceLost only logs, so DeviceLost, the device status and the draw gate react only to the debug hooks
issues.summary: WebGPURenderer sets its lost flag, closes CanBeginDrawEXT() and raises DeviceLost only inside DebugSimulateContextLoss; the callback registered for a real loss only writes to stderr. CNA's own plan (WEBGPU-182) records the driver-reported path as not done and unverified, so this is an incomplete feature rather than a broken contract.
issues.public_contract: GraphicsDevice::DeviceLost / DeviceReset, getGraphicsDeviceStatusProperty() and the CanBeginDrawEXT() gate behind GraphicsDeviceManager::BeginDraw, on the WEBGPU renderer

issues.title: The renderer capability profile has no feature for pre-compiled SPIR-V payloads, so SDL_GPU and VULKAN report every source-dialect feature Unsupported
issues.summary: BuildRendererCapabilityProfileEXT maps a renderer's declared dialect onto six source-dialect features (desktop GLSL, GLSL ES, Vulkan GLSL, HLSL, MSL, WGSL). SDL_GPU and VULKAN declare SpirV, which CNA documents as already-compiled bytecode rather than source text, so all six read Unsupported by design and the profile has no entry that says a SPIR-V payload is accepted.
issues.public_contract: CNA::RendererCapabilityProfile ShaderDialect* features (GraphicsDevice::GetRendererCapabilityProfileEXT)

issues.title: A runtime .cnj Texture2D colorKey leaves keyed texels as straight-alpha (key RGB, alpha 0), so they are invisible only under a non-premultiplied blend state
issues.summary: The loose-tier .cnj Texture2D reader writes Color(keyR, keyG, keyB, 0) into a straight-alpha texture, deliberately, and CnjSourceFileTests pins it. Under SpriteBatch's default premultiplied AlphaBlend such a texel adds the key colour instead of vanishing; the compiled route premultiplies after keying and clears it.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager::Load<Texture2D>(name) for a .cnj Texture2D document with colorKey; SpriteBatch::Begin() default BlendState::AlphaBlend

issues.title: Video playback is unavailable on Windows, MinGW, Emscripten, Android and iOS: CNA has no FFmpeg integration for those targets yet
issues.summary: modules/CMakeLists.txt marks those targets as outside the FFmpeg integration, so CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO=AUTO falls back to the no-video backend and ON fails configuration; Video probing and VideoPlayer::Play then throw NotSupportedException. docs/video-backend.md describes this as 'no target-native FFmpeg integration or decode verification yet' (MEDIA-192 to MEDIA-195), so it is unfinished CNA work rather than a constraint of those platforms.
issues.public_contract: Video, VideoPlayer and Load<Video> on WIN32/MinGW, Emscripten, Android and iOS builds

issues.title: CANVAS and FREEDIRECT throw for any Texture2D mip level above 0, so mipmapped textures (including XNB textures with mip chains) cannot be uploaded
issues.summary: CanvasTextureRenderer::UpdatePixelsLevel and FreeDirect's texture renderers throw std::runtime_error for level > 0 because Canvas 2D and DirectDraw surfaces have no mip chain; the XNB Texture2D reader uploads every level it reads.
issues.public_contract: Texture2D::SetData(level > 0, ...) and ContentManager::Load<Texture2D> of mipmapped assets on CANVAS and FREEDIRECT

issues.title: SDL_GPU ignores BlendState.MultiSampleMask because SDL_gpu reserves its sample-mask fields
issues.summary: SDL 3.5.0 documents SDL_GPUMultisampleState::sample_mask/enable_mask as reserved (must be 0/false), so SdlGpuRenderer::ApplyBlendState drops the mask and a partial MultiSampleMask renders all samples without an error.
issues.public_contract: BlendState.MultiSampleMask / GraphicsDevice.MultiSampleMask on SDL_GPU

issues.title: EasyGL on GLES/WebGL contexts without GL_NV_polygon_mode or WEBGL_polygon_mode refuses wireframe triangle draws
issues.summary: FillMode::WireFrame triangle draws throw NotSupportedException there instead of being approximated with lines; GraphicsCapability::WireFrame reports false so a game can choose Solid.
issues.public_contract: RasterizerState.FillMode = WireFrame on the GLES and WebGL EasyGL profiles

issues.title: On OpenGL ES 3.0 and WebGL 2 contexts OcclusionQuery::PixelCount is boolean (0 or 1)
issues.summary: Those APIs only offer GL_ANY_SAMPLES_PASSED, so EasyGL reports whether any sample passed rather than how many; isPixelCountPreciseEXT() reports which kind of count is in effect.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::OcclusionQuery::PixelCount on EasyGL GLES/WebGL profiles

issues.title: SDL_GPU cannot create OcclusionQuery objects because SDL_gpu 3.5.0 has no occlusion-query commands
issues.summary: SdlGpuRenderer::CreateOcclusionQuery throws NotSupportedException: SDL_gpu exposes no query pools, and its fences report only command-buffer completion.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::OcclusionQuery on SDL_GPU

issues.title: Under Wine or Proton, Direct2D lacks the ColorMatrix effect and ignores bounded-copy and Porter-Duff composite modes, so tinted or NonPremultiplied RenderTarget2D sprite sources throw there
issues.summary: The Direct2D parity test skips its render-target decoration and advanced-blend matrices on those runtimes, and a tinted or NonPremultiplied RenderTarget2D sprite source throws NotSupportedException there (D2D-85).
issues.public_contract: SpriteBatch drawing a RenderTarget2D with a tint or NonPremultiplied blend on DIRECT2D under Wine/Proton

issues.title: On browsers without mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter, HTML_DOM and SVG_DOM draw BlendState.Additive as ordinary composition without an error
issues.summary: The renderers set mix-blend-mode to plus-lighter for additive sprites; a browser that does not support it ignores the value, and only the memoised AdditiveBlending capability (CSS.supports) reveals the difference.
issues.public_contract: SpriteBatch with BlendState::Additive on HTML_DOM and SVG_DOM

issues.title: ScrollWheelValue granularity depends on the platform backend: SDL3 drops sub-notch wheel motion, Win32 and Wayland keep it
issues.summary: The SDL3 mouse service truncates every wheel event to whole notches before scaling by 120, so high-resolution wheels and touchpads can scroll without changing ScrollWheelValue, while the Win32 and Wayland backends accumulate 1/120 units as XNA does.
issues.public_contract: MouseState::getScrollWheelValueProperty() and getHorizontalScrollWheelValueEXTProperty() as reported by Mouse::GetState()

issues.title: Android Compass and Motion: stopping waits at most five seconds for the sensor worker, after which the bridge is abandoned for good and a handler still running can outlive its owner
issues.summary: AndroidSensorBridge::Stop gives a wedged worker five seconds and then detaches it, marking the bridge permanently unable to start; a Compass or Motion destroyed after such a timeout, while a callback is still inside it, is an unsupported window.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Devices::Sensors::Compass and Motion on Android (AndroidCompassBackend and AndroidMotionBackend over Detail::AndroidSensorBridge): Start(), Stop(), Dispose() and destruction

issues.title: Under Emscripten nothing mounts a persistent file system, so saves and the local gamer-services store are lost on page reload
issues.summary: No IDBFS mount or FS.syncfs call exists in the tree, so storage writes go to Emscripten's in-memory file system.
issues.public_contract: StorageDevice/StorageContainer and LocalGamerServicesStore in Emscripten builds

issues.title: Under Emscripten, SystemLink discovery is empty, hosting binds the fixed port 61191 and Join returns before the handshake
issues.summary: The web build stubs out discovery (Find returns nothing), hosts on a fixed port only a Node.js relay can use, rebuilds a joining session as an outbound-only client and returns from Join before the server welcome; Node.js-run unit tests cover discovery and loopback handshakes, but no browser or two-process test exists.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Net::NetworkSession Create, Find, Join and Update for NetworkSessionType::SystemLink in Emscripten builds

issues.title: Wayland gives no desktop pointer position, and browsers hide gamepads until a button press and gate pointer lock on a user gesture
issues.summary: On native Wayland the global-pointer functions are unsupported; on the web a gamepad appears only after the player presses a button on it, and relative mouse mode engages only after a click.
issues.public_contract: Mouse::GetGlobalPositionEXT / WarpGlobalEXT / SetCaptureEXT on Wayland; GamePad connection and Mouse relative mode in Emscripten builds

issues.title: Compass and Motion work only on Android; desktop sensors come only through the SDL3 platform, and web targets are refused
issues.summary: Compass::IsSupported and Motion::IsSupported are false everywhere except Android because SDL3 exposes no magnetometer or fused-orientation API; Accelerometer and Gyroscope are supported on Android, iOS and desktop but never in a browser.
issues.public_contract: Compass, Motion, Accelerometer and Gyroscope IsSupported per target

issues.title: Windows builds leave out Sharp Runtime's Xml.Serialization, so the XmlSerializationEXT surface of the math and input types is unavailable there
issues.summary: On every Windows target CNA leaves Xml.Serialization out of its Sharp Runtime closure and drops both XmlSerializationEXTTests, although the sharp-runtime include problem behind the exclusion has since been fixed upstream.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft/Xna/Framework/XmlSerializationEXT.hpp (math) and Microsoft/Xna/Framework/Input/XmlSerializationEXT.hpp on Windows targets

issues.title: Matrix camera builders have no XNA oracle and no full-matrix value test
issues.summary: CreateLookAt and the perspective and orthographic builders are asserted only on single terms and covered indirectly by consumer tests; CNA's XNA matrix oracle does not include them.
issues.public_contract: Matrix::CreateLookAt, CreatePerspective, CreatePerspectiveFieldOfView, CreatePerspectiveOffCenter, CreateOrthographic and CreateOrthographicOffCenter

issues.title: BoundingSphere::CreateFromBoundingBox and the SmoothStep/Hermite/CatmullRom helpers use different arithmetic from XNA 4.0, and no oracle measures last-bit agreement
issues.summary: CreateFromBoundingBox and the SmoothStep/Hermite/CatmullRom helpers compute with formulas or precision that differ from XNA's, and only CreateFromPoints has an XNA oracle.
issues.public_contract: BoundingSphere::CreateFromBoundingBox; MathHelper::SmoothStep, Hermite, CatmullRom; Vector2/3/4::SmoothStep and Hermite

issues.title: EffectParameter's lenient mode for CNA-constructed parameters is untested, including a SetValue(Texture*) that GetValueTexture2D() does not read back
issues.summary: Parameters without compiled storage accept SetValue(string) on any record, ignore type metadata and store SetValue(Texture*) where the typed getters do not look; only compiled-mode checks are tested.
issues.public_contract: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Graphics::EffectParameter SetValue/GetValue on stock-effect and standalone parameters

issues.title: The Linux evdev controller-mapping reader is tested only on hand-written entries in CI; the real-database test always skips
issues.summary: LinuxEvdevMapping.EveryEntryOfADatabaseFileIsRead skips unless CNA_TEST_GAMECONTROLLERDB names a file, no workflow sets it, and mapped-pad behaviour with physical generic HID pads has no recorded evidence.
issues.public_contract: CNA_GAMECONTROLLERCONFIG_FILE / CNA_GAMECONTROLLERCONFIG on the X11 and Wayland evdev gamepad hub

issues.title: The SDL3 camera provider, system-tray icon and file-dialog result path have no test that drives them

issues.title: Android and iOS have no device evidence at this snapshot: no Android workflow, one iOS simulator frame, and lifecycle and packaged-content loading untested on a device
issues.summary: Android has no preset or workflow, iOS evidence is a device final-link plus a one-frame simulator launch, lifecycle is tested only with scripted host events, and no test loads packaged content on a device.

issues.title: GraphicsDeviceManager's iOS/Android back-buffer orientation branch has no test
issues.summary: On iOS and Android GraphicsDeviceManager reshapes the preferred back buffer by DisplayOrientation and forwards SupportedOrientations to the window; the desktop test skips itself on those platforms and the iOS lane only launches a one-frame smoke app.

issues.title: No CI workflow builds or tests the OPENGL4 renderer
issues.summary: OPENGL4, declared Supported and merged at this snapshot with several hundred family CTests, is named by none of the 20 workflows, so its evidence is CNA's recorded runs on one Radeon 780M under Mesa, and Windows and macOS are unvalidated.
issues.public_contract: The OPENGL4 renderer identity (GraphicsBackendMaturity::Supported) and its CTest suites

issues.title: No test exercises PlatformSelection.cmake's reserved-identifier and unknown-name refusal paths
issues.summary: PlatformSelection.cmake fails configure for SDL12, EMSCRIPTEN, WIN32 off Windows, TERMINAL on Windows and unknown names, but the only platform-selection configure test, CnaWaylandPlatformSelection, covers Wayland alone.

issues.title: No CI workflow selects CNA_PLATFORM=WAYLAND, so the native Wayland backend's suites run only on a developer's machine
issues.summary: The Wayland ctest suites are registered only under CNA_PLATFORM=WAYLAND and launched through tools/platform/wayland_test_server.sh, but no GitHub workflow configures that platform, so the native Wayland backend has no continuous integration.

issues.title: No gate checks include reachability or compiles each public C++ header alone; the two scripts that did are stale campaign tools wired to nothing
issues.summary: check_include_reachability.py and check_header_self_containment.py hard-code the August 2026 module graph and are called by no CMake file, test or workflow, and no current gate compiles each framework public C++ header in isolation.

issues.title: The physical source-partition validator checks only *.cpp/*.mm path prefixes, so headers, C sources and a TU in a renderer's src/ subdirectory (never compiled) all pass it
issues.summary: modules/CMakeLists.txt's no-loss ownership gate globs only .cpp and .mm and compares path prefixes, while cna_add_renderer globs src/*.cpp non-recursively, so a new TU under src/<subdir>/ passes configure and is silently not built.
issues.public_contract: modules/CMakeLists.txt physical source-partition validator; modules/renderers/CMakeLists.txt cna_add_renderer

issues.title: CNA records and checks no easy-gl or meta-gl revision, although the snapshot needs meta-gl 20c8b2dc or later and easy-gl deda7a42 or later
issues.summary: EasyGLRenderer.cpp needs meta-gl's InternalFormat::Rgba16 (from 20c8b2dc) and RendererSelection.cmake relies on easy-gl's exception-model variable (from deda7a42), yet nothing pins or checks either sibling revision.
issues.public_contract: GL-family builds (OPENGLES2, OPENGLES3, OPENGL33, WEBGL1, WEBGL2) consuming ../easy-gl and ../meta-gl

issues.title: A plain ctest run of the tests preset is not a trustworthy result
issues.summary: CNA's own tests preset records that ctest reports unbuilt display-dependent smoke executables as failed and races tests that share hard-coded /tmp fixture paths across processes, so only a direct CnaTests run is authoritative.
issues.public_contract: ctest over a build of the tests preset (CMakePresets.json)

issues.title: graphics-ext shader-package drift guards have holes: no reproducibility check for shadow_caster, none run in CI, desktop clustered-forward fragment unpinned
issues.summary: Two checked-in packages (shadow_caster and the test package modern_resource_interop) have no ShaderPackageReproducibility CTest, CI installs no shaderc so every such CTest skips, and only the ES clustered-forward fragment is pinned to the public GLSL helpers.
issues.public_contract: Checked-in shader packages of modules/graphics-ext (package.json plus generated header) used by ShadowMap, SpotShadowMap and ClusteredForwardEffect

issues.title: No test asserts RenderPipeline's fixed post-process order; the order-named tests only count passes
issues.summary: RenderPipeline::end() adds up to fourteen built-in passes and the user passes in a deliberate order, but the three tests named after that order assert only getLastFramePassCount(), so any permutation passes.
issues.public_contract: Built-in pass order of CNA::Graphics::RenderPipeline::end() (CNAEXT engine layer)

issues.title: ModuleLinkClosure_* link-closure gates report CTest SKIP in every Ninja tree, so no preset-based run and no CI job ever evaluates them
issues.summary: check_module_link_closure.py reads the make-only CMakeFiles/<target>.dir/link.txt and exits 77 when it is missing; the Ninja presets and every CI job either use Ninja or never run these tests, so CNA's module dependency contracts are not checked automatically.
issues.public_contract: The ModuleLinkClosure_* CTests registered by cmake/Tests/ModuleProbes.cmake (cna_add_module_probe and the CnaExtComposition, NetHasENet, NativeSdkFree_*, GraphicsNativeSdkFree and VulkanRendererClosure probes)

issues.title: TerminalPresenterThroughPlatformTest is not matched by the aggregate CnaPlatformTests filter, so the terminal CI cell never runs it
issues.summary: The CnaPlatformTests filter token TerminalPresenter.* does not match TerminalPresenterThroughPlatformTest; it runs only through per-case discovery in an unfiltered ctest, so the terminal CI cell (^CnaPlatformTests$) skips it.
issues.public_contract: cmake/UnitTests.cmake CnaPlatformTests filter coverage of the terminal presenter's through-the-platform case

issues.title: SpriteFont/DrawString pixel tests exist only for EasyGL, OPENGL4, SOFTWARE, SDL_RENDERER, VULKAN, the DIRECTX11/12 parity set and FREEDIRECT
issues.summary: The other renderer families (among them SDL_GPU, WEBGPU, DIRECTX9, DIRECT2D, GDI, METAL, the browser renderers and FNA3D) rely on shared glyph-layout code without any text pixel test.
issues.public_contract: SpriteBatch::DrawString / SpriteFont rendering per renderer

issues.title: No test measures presentation cadence: PresentInterval::Two against ordinary vsync, or Vulkan's FIFO_RELAXED late-frame behaviour
issues.summary: The registered interval tests on EasyGL, SDL_RENDERER, SDL_GPU, VULKAN and the shared forwarding contract check storage, forwarding and the selected present mode, not the resulting frame timing.
issues.public_contract: PresentationParameters.PresentationInterval (One, Two, Immediate) and the renderers' swap-interval / present-mode mapping

issues.title: Most browser renderer paths are never executed automatically: WEBGL1/WEBGL2 have no test registrations, CANVAS has no registered browser run, and SVG_DOM runs only through a manual script
issues.summary: WebGL identities have no test registrations and CI only builds a WEBGL2 bundle, CANVAS test programs are not registered, and the DOM host-contract suites are opt-in with no workflow; only HTML_DOM has a CI browser run.
issues.public_contract: WEBGL1, WEBGL2, CANVAS, SVG_DOM (and HTML_DOM host contracts) renderer identities

issues.title: METAL's CI lane proves construction, clear/present and capability reporting but no representative 3D pixels
issues.summary: metal-macos-ci.yml runs only ctest -R '^Metal' (Metal_Smoke, Metal_Capabilities, Metal_PortableHelpers) and the compile-definition tests; no textured, lit or depth-tested 3D output is checked on macOS.
issues.public_contract: The METAL renderer's 3D pipeline (stock effects, depth, textures) on macOS

issues.title: No CI workflow selects WEBGPU or SDL_GPU; WebGPU evidence is local Linux and scripted headless Chrome, and SDL_GPU's Direct3D 12 and Metal driver routes have no native execution evidence
issues.summary: Neither identity appears in any workflow; WEBGPU's native evidence is Linux x86_64 only, and SDL_GPU's Direct3D 12 route has only Wine/vkd3d-proton runs while its Metal route has none.
issues.public_contract: WEBGPU and SDL_GPU renderer identities (and SDL_GPU's Direct3D 12 and Metal driver routes)

issues.title: The Windows renderer families have no automatic native Windows execution: DIRECTX9 has no CI job, the DIRECTX11/12, DIRECT2D and GDI lanes are manual, and Direct2D's release gate is blocked
issues.summary: The Direct3D and GDI Windows workflows run only on manual dispatch, no workflow selects DIRECTX9, GDI tests are not registered in cross builds, DXGI device removal is only simulated, and the Direct2D release gate is blocked.
issues.public_contract: DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11, DIRECTX12, DIRECT2D and GDI renderer identities on native Windows

issues.title: No workflow runs the roughly eighty SDL_Renderer_* renderer CTests, and they are not registered on Windows or Emscripten
issues.summary: The SDL_RENDERER example tests are registered only when NOT EMSCRIPTEN AND NOT WIN32; input-ci.yml builds SDL_RENDERER but runs ctest -L input, and apple-ci.yml runs CnaTests directly.
issues.public_contract: SDL_RENDERER renderer identity (its SDL_Renderer_* CTests)

issues.title: Several XNB runtime readers are never exercised with externally produced files, although genuine XNA 4.0 outputs for some of them are already in the tree
issues.summary: Texture3D, Curve, Video, DXT1/DXT5 Texture2D, container-version-4 textures and four of the five stock effects are read in tests only from CNA-written or hand-built bytes; the XNA-built differential corpus is used only by pipeline tests.
issues.public_contract: The XNB type readers for Texture3D, Curve, Video, Texture2D (DXT1/DXT5, version 4) and AlphaTestEffect, DualTextureEffect, EnvironmentMapEffect and SkinnedEffect

issues.title: No fuzz target covers .cnj documents or the JSON parser, and .cnj files are read whole with no size bound
issues.summary: The content fuzz suites cover the XNB container, LZX, XNB writer input and the CNB container; ContentManager's ReadTextFile reads any .cnj into memory before parsing, with no counterpart of XnbReadLimits.
issues.public_contract: ContentManager's .cnj tier (ReadTextFile, ParseCnjEnvelope and the per-type .cnj readers)

issues.title: Model drawing on renderers other than EasyGL rests on recorded glTF campaigns; only the OPENGLES3 whole-corpus L7 rung runs in CI
issues.summary: Renderer-local Model draw and hierarchy programs exist only for the EasyGL family; the whole-corpus L7 image campaigns for VULKAN, SOFTWARE and DIRECTX11 are committed reports from one earlier commit, not CI jobs.
issues.public_contract: ModelMesh::Draw / Model::Draw on each 3D renderer; the glTF L7 image comparison

issues.title: The real-world Khronos comparison matrix passes on three renderers; the planned fourth (GLTF ROBUST row 12) is open
issues.summary: Gate C's retake matrix (Fox, DamagedHelmet, Sponza and the sparse cases against the Khronos sample renderer) passes on OPENGLES3, VULKAN and DIRECTX11; the fourth renderer the plan requires is not qualified.
issues.public_contract: glTF import and rendering compared with the Khronos glTF-Sample-Renderer on real assets

issues.title: Input behaviour on real hardware is unverified: the 15-task manual hardware checklist is blocked, and the focus-loss keyboard test checks only the bridge's accumulator
issues.summary: Controllers, touch, IME, non-US layouts, joysticks and host sensors are recorded as unverified on hardware, and the focus-loss keyboard test reads InputManager's legacy state through a local shim, not the public Keyboard::GetState.
issues.public_contract: Keyboard::GetState across focus loss; GamePad, TouchPanel, text input/IME and device input on real hardware

issues.title: The three user-reported audio release blockers (high pitch, missing files, distortion) have never been compared against the original game
issues.summary: plans/plan_audio.md keeps its three user-reported release blockers unchecked; one hypothesis class was ruled out offline, but no capture of the affected game under XNA and CNA exists.
issues.public_contract: Audio playback rate, pitch and loading fidelity for real XNA games

issues.title: CNA's audio plan carries two undiagnosed test-suite crashes (AUD-15-021, AUD-15-022) that have not been re-run at this snapshot

issues.public_contract: The audio test suites (CueTest, DynamicSoundEffectInstanceTest, AudioMixerSpecOverrideTest) and the code they exercise

issues.title: DynamicSoundEffectInstance's PendingBufferCount accounting is untested when the stream resamples
issues.summary: PendingBufferCount compares submitted chunk sizes with the stream's queued-byte count; every test uses a 44,100 Hz source matching the mixer, so the accounting under rate or format conversion is unestablished.

issues.title: Android sensor conventions are unverified on hardware, and the default landscape remap is a reflection, not a rotation
issues.summary: No hardware QA record exists for Microsoft::Devices; CNA's own MOT2-001 analysis found the default-on landscape remap negates one axis (determinant -1), and the Android compass/motion sign conventions and demo copy are unverified or stale.
issues.public_contract: Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Compass and Motion readings on Android; SetAndroidLandscapeRemapEnabled

issues.title: CNA::Devices extension tests run only against canned platforms and compile to nothing unless CNA_DEVICES=ON
issues.summary: Every devices-ext test body is wrapped in #ifdef CNA_DEVICES (default OFF), and the tests drive canned platform services; real dialogs, trays, cameras, clipboards and permissions are not exercised.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Devices (Camera, Clipboard, DisplayInfo, FileDialog, Locale, MessageBox, PowerInfo, SystemInfo, SystemTray, UrlLauncher)

issues.title: No C++ storage test writes bytes through a StorageContainer stream and reads them back
issues.summary: StorageDeviceTests.cpp checks containment, directory operations and file existence; the only byte round trip is the C ABI smoke test, which runs only in builds with the C API.
issues.public_contract: StorageContainer::CreateFile / OpenFile streams

issues.title: The process-spawning networking tests are compiled out on Windows, Emscripten, Android and iOS, and multi-machine behaviour has no test evidence
issues.summary: TwoProcessLoopbackTest.cpp and GamerServicesDispatcherHangRegressionTest.cpp are filtered out for WIN32, EMSCRIPTEN, ANDROID and iOS; multi-machine discovery, host migration, Windows shared-port binding and browser paths are untested.
issues.public_contract: NetworkSession over ENet (SystemLink) on every target

issues.title: Avatar rendering evidence uses a synthetic one-bone quad; no renderer test draws the bundled 19-bone avatar content
issues.summary: The three avatar pixel programs build their own one-bone quad and run on EasyGL, Vulkan and (through the EasyGL parity corpus) OpenGL4; no renderer test draws the shipped avatar meshes, skeleton or animations.
issues.public_contract: AvatarRenderer real rendering (EnableRealRenderingEXT/DrawRealEXT) with the bundled content

issues.title: The CNA_STRICT_XNA_API purity check compiles only the Microsoft::Devices sensor surface
issues.summary: cna_strict_xna_api_check and its must-fail twin include only Microsoft::Devices and Sensors headers, so no automated check covers strict-mode purity or marker completeness of the graphics, content, input, audio, media or runtime surfaces.
issues.public_contract: CNA_STRICT_XNA_API and the CNAEXT marker (StrictXnaApiSurfaceCheck_Compile_Run, StrictXnaApiSurfaceLeakCheck_MustFailToCompile)

issues.title: FREEDIRECT is built and tested by no workflow, has been verified on Linux only, and its free-direct and free-api siblings are unpinned
issues.summary: No workflow selects FREEDIRECT or clones free-direct, so its 21 CTests (registered only in a non-Windows, non-Emscripten test build with FREEDIRECT as the default renderer) run only locally, and CNA's own status document leaves Windows and macOS unverified.
issues.public_contract: The FREEDIRECT renderer identity

issues.title: No automatic workflow builds or runs the engine on Windows, and GDI's tests register only in a native Windows tree
issues.summary: The automatic win32-cross job builds and runs only the standalone Win32 platform harness under Wine; every engine-level Windows workflow is manual, and GDI's examples skip CTest registration when cross-compiling.
issues.public_contract: Windows as a CNA host: the WIN32 platform backend and the DIRECTX9/11/12, DIRECT2D and GDI renderers

issues.title: Wine and Proton test routes do not prove which Direct3D or Direct2D implementation served a run
issues.summary: CnaTests' Wine emulator skips the DXVK/vkd3d-proton engagement gate, every Direct2D registration skips it with no d2d1 marker, and the DIRECTX12 Proton route uses a moving Proton build with no log gate.
issues.public_contract: CTest routes for DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11, DIRECTX12 and DIRECT2D in MinGW cross trees

issues.title: Among the browser renderers only HTML_DOM has an automatic browser run, and that lane pins a sharp-runtime revision the snapshot cannot configure against
issues.summary: htmldom-ci.yml drives the HTML_DOM suite in a browser; SVG_DOM's runner script has no caller, CANVAS, WEBGL1 and WEBGL2 have no browser harness, WEBGL1 is built by no workflow, and the Emscripten multi-renderer job only builds a bundle.
issues.public_contract: The web renderer identities CANVAS, HTML_DOM, SVG_DOM, WEBGL1, WEBGL2 and WEBGPU under Emscripten

issues.title: No workflow runs an XNA or FNA oracle comparison, and the FNA value comparison is one-directional
issues.summary: D3D9_XNA_Diff, Fna3d_XNA_Oracle and Software_XnaLineCoverage are in no workflow's test selection, the one reachable oracle CTest runs where Pillow is not installed, and the FNA value-differential harness is manual and reports only keys FNA has.
issues.public_contract: The XNA reference-image corpus CTests and the FNA value-differential harness (tools/fna-reference, cna_reference_dump, scripts/compare-fna-reference.py)

issues.title: Test strength is never measured automatically: no coverage build, no fuzzing campaign, and the Direct2D mutation checker only dry-runs
issues.summary: No workflow or CMake option enables coverage instrumentation, the libFuzzer-capable harnesses are not CTests and run in no campaign, and direct2d_mutation_check.py runs only as --dry-run in a manual workflow.
issues.public_contract: CNA's test-strength instruments: coverage, fuzzing, mutation checking

issues.title: WEBGPU, SDL_GPU and OPENGL4 parity fixtures and the recorded VULKAN, SOFTWARE and DIRECTX11 glTF L7 golden sets are run by no workflow
issues.summary: Only the OPENGLES3 whole-corpus L7 rung runs in CI; WEBGPU, SDL_GPU, OPENGL4, WEBGL1, OPENGLES2, FNA3D, DIRECTX9 and FREEDIRECT are selected by no workflow at all, so their registered parity fixtures are local evidence.
issues.public_contract: Renderer parity fixtures (cna_register_parity_fixtures) and the glTF L7 golden-image rung

issues.title: The XNA API census (331/331 types, 3,627/3,627 members) measures representation only and is a manually run script
issues.summary: Every member row of docs/xna-4-runtime-member-coverage.json records behavior_assessed false, and tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py is run by no workflow or CTest, so behavioural evidence exists only for the subsets named by individual tests and oracles.
issues.public_contract: docs/xna-4-runtime-member-coverage.json and tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py

issues.title: metal_spritebatch_customeffect_test.cpp is compiled by no CMake file and tests a path MetalRenderer refuses
issues.summary: The Metal examples register only Metal_PortableHelpers, Metal_Smoke and Metal_Capabilities; the four-check custom-effect pixel test is referenced nowhere, and MetalRenderer::CreateEffectRenderer refuses custom effects until macOS evidence exists.
issues.public_contract: The METAL renderer's custom-effect path and its test

issues.title: No CI configuration builds diagnostics at STATS or FULL or enables CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR, so most Diagnostics tests and every Inspector test are never compiled in CI
issues.summary: CNA_DIAGNOSTICS and CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR default to OFF and no workflow or preset changes either, so 38 of 40 DiagnosticsTests, the seven audio and graphics diagnostics tests and all 27 Inspector tests run only in local builds.
issues.public_contract: The STATS/FULL diagnostics implementation (CNA_DIAGNOSTICS) and the optional Inspector (CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR) with their test suites

issues.title: The Inspector's WebBridge security checks and Agent::Stop paths have no automated test
issues.summary: No test drives the HTTP bridge (Host check, UI-token gate, 32-connection cap, request parsing, response headers), and no test calls Agent::Stop directly, stops an agent with a client attached, or starts an agent again after stopping one.
issues.public_contract: CNA::Inspector::Detail::WebBridge (the cna-inspector browser bridge) and CNA::Inspector::Agent::Stop

issues.title: No CI workflow builds the C API library or runs its tests
issues.summary: No workflow at this snapshot configures CNA_BUILD_C_API=ON; the C API workflows only run generators, inventories, a release gate and a header compile matrix, so the library and its tests are verified only in local builds.
issues.public_contract: The C API library (CNA_BUILD_C_API) and its test suites under modules/c-api/tests

issues.title: Destroying a caller-created GraphicsDevice while resources on it are still live is allowed by cna_graphics_device_destroy but untested
issues.summary: graphics_device.h says resources on a caller-created device are released with it and the destroy route checks no child count, but every C test destroys the resources first, so what later calls on those resource handles do rests on reading.
issues.public_contract: cna_graphics_device_create / cna_graphics_device_destroy (CNA/C/graphics_device.h) and the resource handles created on a caller-created device

issues.title: Process exit with live EasyGL-family resources whose creating thread has already ended is untested; a binding recorded SIGABRT on an earlier CNA revision
issues.summary: cna-java recorded that a process exiting with a live vertex buffer whose creating thread had ended aborts on the EasyGL renderer identities; CNA's own process-exit teardown test runs on one thread, so this case has no evidence at this snapshot.
issues.public_contract: Process-exit teardown of live C API handles (the runtime handle registry) on the renderer identities served by EasyGL

issues.title: The checked-in shader bytecode headers of VULKAN, SDL_GPU and the Direct3D renderers come from generators that no CTest or workflow runs and that have no --check mode
issues.summary: spirv_shaders.hpp (VULKAN, SDL_GPU), hlsl_shaders.hpp (DIRECTX11/12) and the d3d9_*shaders.hpp headers come from hand-run generators with no --check mode and no CTest or workflow, so a shader source edit without regeneration would go unnoticed.
issues.public_contract: The checked-in generated shader headers of the classic renderers (spirv_shaders.hpp for VULKAN and SDL_GPU, hlsl_shaders.hpp for DIRECTX11/12, d3d9_*shaders.hpp for DIRECTX9) and the generators that produce them

issues.public_contract: docs/migration-guide.md's open EasyGL caveat (Task 933): a full-backbuffer SpriteBatch draw before the first 3D draw of a frame
